The woman glances at her watch and smiles warmly. She speaks in a cheerful, friendly voice, "I think we're right on time!" In the background, a café barista prepares drinks at the counter. The barista calls out in a clear, upbeat tone, "Two cappuccinos ready!" The sound of the espresso machine hissing softly blends with gentle background chatter and the light clinking of cups on saucers.


Style: realistic cinematic 3D render - The robot from the input image stands inside a super-luxurious spaceship cabin, its blue armored body rendered with the same weathered metal texture, riveted plates, goggled helmet, and glowing blue chest gauge as in the input image. Beside it stands a beautiful female android with a sleek polished white body, a smooth rounded face with large expressive eyes, and long flowing silver hair, her posture elegant and poised. The cabin interior features curved brushed-metal walls, rows of soft amber LED light strips, a polished reflective floor, and a large circular viewport showing deep space with stars drifting past. The robot takes a slow step forward with its hook-hand and spear-hand arms swinging naturally at its sides, while the female android turns her head toward the robot and speaks in a soft melodic voice, "Welcome aboard, my companion." A gentle hum of the life-support systems fills the cabin, combined with the soft click of footsteps on the polished floor and the distant chime of an alarm bell. The camera pans slowly from left to right across the two figures, keeping the robot's full body visible against the luxurious backdrop.
